title: AndroidAPS crashes every time I enter the Omnipod tab
symptom: After upgrading to 3.0.0.1, AndroidAPS crashes every time the user enters the Omnipod tab. The user uses Omnipod Eros and OrangeLink for bridge. Restarting phone, link, and AndroidAPS, and rebuilding AndroidAPS did not help. Building another branch (DynamicISF) worked but does not allow closed loop.
fix: The user reports that the dev branch is working, so they will try the next master when a new version comes out. The issue was closed after that.
evidence_quote: Dev branch is working for me, so closing this issue. Will try next master, when new version comes out.
